{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are too low during uptrends, showing significant lag behind true prices",
    "When prices are rising, model under-forecasts by 2-4 points compared to actual movement",
    "Sentiment positivity correlates with model undershoot, especially when prices are in an upward trajectory",
    "Model fails to capture price acceleration peaks, forecasting flatter than actual highs",
    "When prices bottomed recently, model under-predicts the true bottom by 1-3 points",
    "Sentiment turning positive tends to lag behind actual price movements in the model",
    "Model shows mean-reversion bias when prices are volatile, forecasting toward center instead of following momentum"
] }
